name: What kind of warranty should I expect for a new roof installation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty should I expect for a new roof installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a new roof installation, you should typically expect two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty covering the roofing materials and a contractor's warranty covering the workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often range from 20 years to lifetime, depending on the product. Workmanship warranties vary but commonly last between 5 to 10 years. Always ensure these warranties are clearly outlined in your contract for peace of mind.
